versions.content: Service Name Sec OC_ De Init Syntax void Sec OC_ De Init ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x05 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This service stops the secure onboard communication. All buffered I - PDU are removed and have to be obtained again, if needed, after Sec OC_ Init has been called. By a call to Sec OC_ De Init the AUTOSAR Sec OC module is put into a not initialized state (Se c OC_ UNINIT). Available via Sec OC.h
